objective: Trace scheduler-provided GDN metadata across the c2 decode sequence after R82 validated only the first call and the known output divergence remained at token 96.

instrumentation.scope: Multi-request speculative GDN calls only, independently bounded per TP process.

expected_layer_period.interpretation: Repeated groups of 48 identical metadata records should correspond to one backbone verifier step; analyze and verify this grouping rather than assuming it.

decision: Determine whether state columns, accepted counts, token indices, or request width change before the known token-96 divergence. If all 48 layer calls agree within every step and no anomalous transition exists, reject metadata evolution as the cause and localize state contents or arithmetic next.
promotion_boundary: Diagnostic only. Do not publish throughput from the synchronized trace. Any repair must pass strict varied-prompt identity, deterministic repeats, context-depth, concurrency, clean-boot, and speed-floor gates.
